title: X's Starship will orbit Earth for first time during next flight | New Scientist
description: Starship's next test flight will be its first orbital mission. The craft will also release working Starlink V3 satellites for the first time, making the flight the first commercially useful Starship mission
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Physicists are scrambling to make sense of possible dark matter signal | New Scientist
description: Following the possible recent detection of a dark matter particle, researchers have already come up with a veritable cornucopia of possible models for what sort of particle it might have been
author: Leah Crane

title: Fishapod fossil shows early elbows came in a variety of forms | New Scientist
description: The fish that preceded the first four-legged land animals came in a wider variety of forms than we had thought, and fossils show that one had an elbow joint that moved in an oddly restrictive way
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Our brain evolved from two primitive nervous systems that merged | New Scientist
description: The front and back parts of our brain come from different progenitor cells in embryos, which suggests they evolved as separate entities
author: Alice Klein

title: See the dazzling images that won Astronomy Photographer of the Year | New Scientist
description: Stunning pictures of nebulae, stars, the moon and more took top prizes in this year's astrophotography competition, organised by the Royal Observatory in London
author: Leah Crane

title: Robots clash in first naval engagement between uncrewed sea drones | New Scientist
description: Earlier this month, the Ukrainian Navy used an uncrewed vessel to attack and sink an uncrewed naval robot operated by Russian forces
author: David Hambling
